GLUTEN-FREE CERTIFICATION
Client
Willamette Cultured Foods, Inc.
3300 NW Yeon Ave

Facility audited
Portland, OR — fermentation and packaging. Audit conducted 19/05/26 by NSF auditor under the NSF Gluten-Free Certification Program, third edition.
ScopeCertificate validity
Cultured Sour Cream Base 18% MF; Cultured Buttermilk Concentrate; Creme Fraiche Base 36% MF 2026-06-01 to 2027-05-31

Products bearing the certification mark are verified to contain less than 20 ppm gluten, determined by sandwich R5 ELISA on finished product, with ingredient and supplier documentation reviewed annually. Any change of formulation, ingredient supplier or production location must be notified to NSF before certified product is produced under the changed conditions.

Continued certification requires the annual on-site audit and satisfactory analytical results. The certification mark may be used only on the products within the scope shown above and only while this certificate is in force.
